literal: Do not forget blemish-without-they friendship; do not forsake sorrow-in support became-they friendship.
translation: Do not forget the friendship of the flawless. Do not forsake the friendship of those who were your support in times of sorrow.
modern: குற்றமற்றவர்களின் உறவை மறக்கக் கூடாது. துன்பம் வந்த காலத்தில் துணையாக இருந்தவர்களின் நட்பைக் கைவிடக் கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the lasting value of pure relationships and timely help. The word 'மாசற்றார்' refers to people of flawless character, whose friendship should always be cherished in one's memory. 'துப்பு' means strength or support, highlighting how true friends act as a pillar during times of affliction ('துன்பத்துள்'). By placing 'மறவற்க' (do not forget) and 'துறவற்க' (do not forsake) in parallel, the verse teaches that gratitude requires both remembering the good and never abandoning those who stood by us.
